_source: Watched in the owner's Chrome 2026-11-17: frames every ~4 s, words from YouTube's transcript panel. Our own descriptions; shots approximate from sampled frames.

hook.firstFrame: dozens of flag-coloured country shapes lined up at the top of a striped slope
hook.firstLine: Only one country here rolls like a real wheel.

shots.picture: country shapes in flag colours on a striped slope, starting to tip
one red shape pushed off the top line
the whole field tumbling down the slope
Chile's long shape leads then falls flat
the giants, Russia and Brazil, grinding to a stop
Germany's shape takes the lead, others behind
a small unknown shape rolling past the leaders
a tiny island shape sneaking into third place
a round shape closing on the leader near the bottom
the last shape rolling alone, then the slope from the top again

lines.gist: only one country rolls like a wheel; all cut to the same size and pushed
your country is in there, cheer for it; what makes a good wheel
the famous ones fail early, the giants stop after metres
Germany leads, then an unknown country passes; few still moving
a tiny island and a round country close in on the leader
only the perfect wheel is left; push them all again

ending.lastFrame: the slope from the top, as at the start

whyItWorks: a claim in the first line whose answer waits for the end
the viewer is told their own country is in the race and asked about it
a race with a live count (14 of 170 still moving) keeps the stakes rising
underdogs beat the giants; the last line restarts the race into a loop
